runs.content: Fortive's Q3 beat (core growth +7.2%, adjusted EPS $0.77 vs ~$0.70) came with a raised FY26 EPS guide and ~$300M of buybacks, and the stock is drifting up to a 52-week high, +10.2% from its pre-report close; ULVR was trimmed for capacity at +0.31%.

Global Payments closed at a new 52-week high on reports that CD&R and GTCR are exploring a ~$40bn take-private and a Q3 Worldpay-synergy raise, a payments momentum entry with a bid floor that diversifies the healthcare-heavy book; SHEL was trimmed for capacity at −0.89%.
